title: Prime Minister's Office (Monetary Authority of Singapore)
what_it_is: Prime Minister's Office (Monetary Authority of Singapore)

sections.label: MAS monetary policy role
sections.summary: MAS monetary policy will facilitate the economic transition by keeping consumer price inflation low and providing a conducive macroeconomic environment for innovation and investment.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: The Monetary Authority of Singapore’s (MAS') monetary policy will facilitate this economic transition, by ensuring that consumer price inflation is kept low and providing a conducive macroeconomic environment for innovation and investment.

sections.label: Financial Services Industry Transformation Map
sections.summary: The Financial Services ITM sets strategies to grow the sector by 4.3% annually and create 3,000 net jobs plus 1,000 FinTech jobs from 2016 to 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: The Financial Services Industry Transformation Map (ITM) sets out strategies to grow the financial services sector by 4.3% per annum and create annually 3,000 net jobs in financial services and an additional 1,000 in the FinTech sector from 2016 to 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: The ITM comprises three broad thrusts – leveraging global and regional opportunities, embracing innovation and deepening the talent pool.

sections.label: Asset management and fund domiciliation
sections.summary: MAS will anchor deeper asset management capabilities in Singapore and implement the new Singapore Variable Capital Company structure to position Singapore as a global fund management and domiciliation hub.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: MAS will anchor deeper asset management capabilities in Singapore and implement the new Singapore Variable Capital Company structure to position Singapore as a global hub for fund management and domiciliation.

sections.label: PayNow transfers and business payments
sections.summary: MAS worked with industry to roll out PayNow for convenient, secure inter-bank transfers using mobile number or NRIC, and will extend it to businesses for payments and efficiency gains.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: MAS worked with the industry to roll out PayNow, enabling people to make inter-bank transfers conveniently and securely using just their mobile number or National Registration Identity Card (NRIC).

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: PayNow will be extended to allow businesses to pay one another and receive payments from customers seamlessly for efficiency gains and cost reduction.

sections.label: Cyber threat surveillance system
sections.summary: MAS has implemented a 24/7 surveillance system to monitor cyber threats in the financial industry and will strengthen cyber intelligence capabilities and information exchange platforms.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: MAS has implemented a 24/7 surveillance system to monitor cyber threats in the financial industry and will strengthen capabilities in cyber intelligence and enhance platforms for information exchange on cyber incidents.

sections.label: Financial industry conduct guidelines
sections.summary: MAS will propose guidelines to raise conduct standards across the financial industry and step up supervisory reviews on risk governance and culture in financial institutions.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: MAS will propose guidelines to raise standards of conduct across the financial industry and step up supervisory reviews relating to risk governance and culture in financial institutions.
